verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for an open-source agent framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any telemetry or usage-tracking controls or an opt-out mechanism. Self-hosting and keyless local runs are adjacent capabilities, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
